text: Between 14:02 and 14:31 UTC, some users experienced elevated error rates when accessing our API. A recent deploy inadvertently removed a cache warmup step, causing approximately 12% of API requests to fail with HTTP 502 errors during this window. Our monitoring detected the increased error rate shortly after the deploy, and our team began investigating immediately. At 14:27 UTC, the deploy was reverted, which resolved the underlying cause. Error rates returned to normal shortly thereafter, and full service was confirmed restored by 14:31 UTC. We apologize for the disruption and are reviewing our deployment process to prevent similar issues going forward.
